_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Vesopa AI (menu, Vesopa AI, or the spark button at the top). 1. As a manager, open it: the Briefing should show today against the same time last week, yesterday and why, what needs attention and what to do. 2. Ask: tap a suggested question, then a follow-up; each answer shows its period, site, definitions, when the data was last updated and View data. 3. Sales, Profit, Stock and People tabs, and the site picker. 4. As a manager, More (three dots), Invite people: invite your email, then sign on as a member of staff who is not a manager, open Vesopa AI, tap I have an invite code and type the code from the email. 5. Check the figures against the back office's reports for the same day.
release_notes: New: Vesopa AI. A daily briefing, questions about your business in plain words, and sales, profit, stock and team insights, all from your own Vesopa EPOS figures. For managers, and anyone a manager invites by email.
